figurative_meaning_en: to roll on the ground in extreme grief or agony
similar_in_english: throw oneself on the ground in sorrow
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুত্রহারা মা শোকেদুঃখে মাটিতে গড়াগড়ি দিচ্ছে।
দুর্ঘটনার সংবাদ শুনে সে শোকে গড়াগড়ি দিতে লাগল।
example_sentences_in_english: The mother who lost her son is rolling on the ground in grief and sorrow.
Upon hearing the news of the accident, she began rolling on the ground in anguish.
note: This idiom vividly captures traditional Bengali expressions of profound loss, often seen in folk literature and dramas.
